literal: Добавить read-only doctor для missing/corrupt blobs, dangling refs/work, duplicate application, stale generation, orphaned batch, missing receipt и archive coverage. Ремонт и повтор отправки не выполняются doctor автоматически.
decision: OPEN: one demonstrated inverse continuation-child availability residual; no checkbox edits

root_full.provenance: parent final verified message; rootfull-v3 artifacts

commands.request: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.request_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/request.json
commands.work: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.work_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/work.json
commands.computation: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.computation_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/computation.json --supplement-deliveries
commands.source: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.source_history_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/source.json --candidate-traces --selection-coverage
commands.content: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.content_history_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/content.json
commands.batch: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.batch_integrity_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/batch.json --batch-receipts
commands.retained: uv run --offline --frozen python -m tools.retained_integrity_doctor --database COPY.db --output out/retained.json

retained_bodies.boundary: Strict serialization/recognized legacy refs ERROR. Explicit attention-v1 model failures ERROR. Successfully decoded legacy/unknown model layouts unavailable/advisory. NULL/legitimately cleaned data unknown; no raw-original retention claim.

dangling_refs_work.boundary: Exact typed/source/profile edges below, no current-owner equality or arbitrary JSON reachability. Continuation parent availability is covered, inverse root.continuation_ids availability is not: RESIDUAL-1.

duplicate_application.boundary: Actual result/owner/generation/phase or generationless explicit target namespace/ref key. Nullable generation+target invalid under model/migration50; distinct targets/phases/generations valid. Not duplicate billing inference.

stale_generation.boundary: Only explicit primary generation on queued/submitting intents/unconsumed items vs exact current owner. Advisory; unknown generation/owner explicit. Other8purposes and generationless document/review/revision work are not assigned invented generations.

orphaned_batch.boundary: Item-without-batch ERROR. Saved batch request_count vs all retained items inclconsumed/forgotten; deficit advisory, excess/invalid count ERROR. Missing schema/count evidence unknown/null, no provider-output/current-owner inference.

missing_receipt.boundary: All10retained purposes, exact(provider,batch,custom), both-known SHA and actual typed item purpose. Missing receipt advisory; known conflicts ERROR. SameSHA elsewhere/currentconsumer never substitute. Batch header may be mixed.

archive_coverage.boundary: Known metadata IDs/parents, coverage/count/ordinal/bounds/selected physical rows. Omitted/truncated/unknown prefixes explicit. No full raw traversal, future omitted-member legality or raw-object existence claim.

read_only_no_auto_action.boundary: mode=ro&immutable, reject livejournal/WAL, hash before/after, separate create-only outputs. No provider, model, repair, retry, migration or send action.

persisted_classes.coverage: Frozen request SHA/key/provider, prepared/timing/input parents; active explicit primary generation; no reconstruction of erased inputs.
Original receipt/purpose/knownSHA/population; typed retained accounting payload; consumed/forgotten rows retained.
SQL/JSON immutable identity and typed validated/error record; original paid scope independent of mutable consumer.
Typed indexed identity, known result and explicit target presence; opaque future namespaces/historical absent owners not reinterpreted.
Exact retained body/receipt/explicit alias rules via primary_projection_issues; no borrowed ownership.

persisted_classes.carrier: status amendments; bills joint/reviews; bills/status supplements
persisted_classes.coverage: Nonnull modernIDs validated result/purpose/both-knownSHA; review2representations; legacyNone unknown, no answer/display/currentowner equality.
Typed original input/result/memo owner guards; no caller context reconstruction.
Same exact paid validator for current+previous, analysis/reanalysis/name/foreign admitted; manualNone/unknownSHA preserved. Current producers bind only selected current candidates; proposals unbound.
Indexed key/owner/state/schedule, Bill/change and changeowner, publication availability; declared Bill/detail/stage/document/context bodies typed.
Result/request/original pub/channel and content snapshots; queued target/receipt; retained cleaned context admitted. Explicit frozen owner contract, not currentBill equality.
Typed work/context/duplicateowner, contextnumber/purpose, frozen inputBill; empty legacy/abandoned context stays unavailable.
Snapshot identity/type/parents/predecessor/root/binding, profiled paid/source refs, physical confirmation. Compactcard fullcontext intentionally unavailable, not corruption.
Shared typed metadata identities/links/counts; no current source fetching/owner revalidation; bounded prefixes remain explicit.

persisted_classes.carrier: legacy_* tables and admitted projection columns
persisted_classes.coverage: Existing exact original-body/value/manifest/FK/reference guards, no historical paidcalls/default upcast.
Native declared model fields +legacy hydration; cleaned/unknown profiles explicit. Local continuation_parent presence covered. Inverse continuation_ids still unassessed (RESIDUAL-1).

persisted_classes.carrier: amendment_input_snapshots; intent/item meta and computation result ref
persisted_classes.coverage: Default computation_doctor amendment_input_issues validates canonical full question/snapshot IDs, actual carrier purpose/requestSHA/inputbinding, known receipt and original lineage result/source parents. None refs/older schema unknown; missing required v67 table/broken known refs boundederrors. ReaderA writerOFF; no natural rows fabricated.

boundaries.deferred_na: Raw original legislative/archive bytes, filesystem/object store and complete raw traversal; separate approved DA2 deferral. Retained application bodies remain applicable and checked.
boundaries.legacy: Allowed absence/cleaned/unprofiled data stays unavailable; no historical refs, clocks, semantic labels or currentowner equality invented.
boundaries.finite_claim: No universal arbitrary JSON/wholeDB semantic validation claim. Counts name stored row/field/edge observations, not unique bills/paidcalls or complete past events.

resolved_original_findings: Imported shared body/value/manifest known corruption and parents diagnosed via shared runtime guards
Known native protected bodies diagnosed; legacy current-model incompatibility explicitly advisory after strict storage/ref parsing
Current and actual public rename previous paid name refs diagnosed with one finite validator
Known continuation_parent localPublication availability diagnosed advisory

remaining.producer: services/message_parts.py::freeze_parts stores actual repo-created child PublicationIDs; send_continuations iterates and asserts child row exists
remaining.demonstration: Real public freeze_parts/FakePublisher splittingonly creates >1children. Delete LAST child so all surviving continuation_parent edges remain valid. Root still holds explicit missing childID. All8diagnostics add zero findings.
remaining.classification: Missing historical child should be availability/advisory, never corruption/send/retry inference; no new namespace or provider link needed.
remaining.status: parent assigned isolated J254; not implemented/accepted in J252
